labels.text: When reviewing or fixing someone else's PR, don't ask for or open an issue, but note in the review when an external contributor's PR changes public API without one.
labels.label: judgment
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:338 '**Already have a PR open?** Don't stop or rewrite it. Call out the public API change at the top of the PR description, and link or open an issue' (contributor-side rule; the agent-specific review behavior is not encoded anywhere)
labels.note: Agent review-process instruction that no tooling or code in the repository can confirm or contradict.

labels.text: The author is a PostHog maintainer when the PR's `author_association` is `MEMBER` or `OWNER` (`gh api repos/PostHog/posthog-js/pulls/<number> --jq .author_association`) or, before a PR exists, when `gh api orgs/PostHog/members/$(gh api user --jq .login)` succeeds. If the check fails or can't run, treat the author as an external contributor.
labels.label: judgment
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:334 'PostHog maintainers (members of the PostHog GitHub org) agree on API shape in the PR itself' (consistent definition)
packages/browser/package.json:8 '"repository": "https://github.com/PostHog/posthog-js"' (repo slug in the command is correct)
grep -rn 'author_association' .github => no matches (no tooling implements this check)
labels.note: Depends on the external GitHub API and is an agent process rule; the repo slug and maintainer definition are consistent but the check itself cannot be settled from the repository.

labels.text: A published [sdk-spec](https://github.com/PostHog/sdk-specs) that defines the API counts as the agreement, so no issue is needed.
labels.label: true
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:337 '**Already specified?** If a published [sdk-spec](https://github.com/PostHog/sdk-specs) defines the API, that's the agreement, so you don't need an issue.'
labels.note: The canonical contributor policy in CONTRIBUTING.md states the same rule nearly verbatim.

labels.text: For an external contributor with no agreed issue and no spec, stop before implementing and draft the issue body for the user to post. Open it only if they ask.
labels.label: judgment
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:336 '**Before you start:** ... open an issue describing your use case. Wait for a maintainer to agree on the API shape there before you implement it.' (related contributor rule; the agent-specific draft-only behavior is not encoded)
labels.note: Agent workflow instruction that the repository cannot verify or contradict.

labels.text: Before implementing or reviewing SDK behavior, check [PostHog/sdk-specs](https://github.com/PostHog/sdk-specs) for a spec covering it (its README lists every capability). If one exists, use it as the cross-SDK contract for the behavior the PR changes, and call out any divergence in that behavior in the PR description. Don't fix or flag discrepancies between the spec and code the PR doesn't touch. If none exists, carry on.
labels.label: judgment
evidence: .github/workflows/sdk-compliance-tests-node-v2.yml:151 '// Packaged feature paths are relative to the sdk-specs repository root.' (repo does use PostHog/sdk-specs, but its README contents are external)
labels.note: Process instruction about an external repository whose README contents cannot be checked from this repo.
